summary: AMETEK Inc. announced a definitive agreement to acquire Indicor Instrumentation, a portfolio of instrumentation businesses from Indicor, LLC, for $5.0 billion in an all-cash transaction. The target generates ~$1.1 billion in annual sales with profitability consistent with AMETEK. The board recommends the deal; no advisor named. Funding comes from AMETEK's existing credit facility and new debt issuance. The acquisition will integrate into AMETEK's EIG and EMG segments. Closing is subject to regulatory approvals; watch for antitrust clearance timing and financing conditions.
